item.title: Binance Highlights Smart Contracts as Blockchain Automation Grows
item.summary: Binance has highlighted the role of smart contracts in converting blockchain-based rules into automated actions, underscoring how programmable agreements are being used to improve efficiency across cryptocurrency markets and decentralized applications. Smart contracts enable predefined blockchain rules to be executed automatically when specified conditions are met, reducing the need for manual processing and third-party intermediaries.
